title: CB-Orchestrator: Adaptive Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents via Contextual Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2610.13064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. translated_title: CB-Orchestrator：基于上下文老虎机的LLM智能体自适应工作流优化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过智能体工作流在解决复杂任务方面展现出了卓越的能力。然而，人工设计这些工作流既费时费力，又缺乏适应多样化查询的灵活性。虽然自动化工作流优化是一个有前景的方向，但现有方法在训练阶段的反馈收集过程中往往会产生高昂的API成本。此外，它们无法自适应地复用高质量的工作流，这对性能和成本效益都形成了瓶颈。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了CB-Orchestrator，这是一个将工作流生成与选择解耦的自适应框架。在第一阶段，我们通过进化搜索构建了一个多样化的候选工作流池。在第二阶段，我们将工作流选择形式化为一个上下文老虎机问题，通过平衡探索与利用实现样本高效的学习，从而显著……
tldr: 提出CB-Orchestrator自适应框架，将工作流生成与选择解耦，通过进化搜索构建多样化候选工作流池，并将工作流选择建模为上下文老虎机问题，实现样本高效学习，兼顾性能与成本效益。
en_tdlr: CB-Orchestrator decouples workflow generation from selection, building a diverse candidate workflow pool via evolutionary search and formulating workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, enabling sample-efficient learning that improves both performance and cost-effectiveness for LLM agent workflows.
